description: Offline TTS: the Piper Windows binary and the voices the game uses. Fetch with `node scripts/voices-fetch.mjs` (zip cached in tools/_downloads/, extracted to tools/piper/, voices into assets/voices/). All of those are gitignored; this manifest is committed.
notes: Binary: rhasspy/piper 2023.11.14-2 (last release of the original MIT repo, archived). The successor OHF-Voice/piper1-gpl v1.8.0 ships only Python wheels (no standalone .exe) and is GPL-3.0, so the MIT binary release is used.

The Windows zip also bundles espeak-ng (espeak-ng.dll + espeak-ng-data), which is GPL-3.0. We never modify or redistribute it: Setup.bat downloads the official zip on the player's machine and the game only runs piper.exe as a separate process.

Voices: every voice is trained on public-domain LibriVox audio by Bryce Beattie (trained from scratch, except john which is fine-tuned from kristin). en_US-lessac-* was rejected: its dataset (Lessac Blizzard 2013) is licensed for research purposes only. Voices fine-tuned from lessac (joe, amy, alan, alba, northern_english_male, hfc_*) were rejected for the same inheritance; ryan and hfc_* also have CC BY-NC-SA datasets.
URLs are pinned to the piper-voices v1.0.0 tag on Hugging Face; bytes + sha256 are verified after every download.
